title: Streaming
lead: Play the games of your other PlayOut computers on this one. PC games stream over the network; ROM games can also be downloaded.

sync.label: Sync the Emulation folder
sync.description: Keeps the Emulation folder (BIOS, saves, states and the rest) the same on this PC and the computers it is paired with, both ways, every few minutes and after each game. Its roms and texturepacks folders are left out. When both computers changed the same file, the newer one is kept and the older one goes to the backups for 30 days. Both computers need this on.

sync.title: Library tabs, favourites and play time

tabs.label: Sync Library tabs with the host / clients
tabs.description: Keeps the Library tabs the same on this PC and the computers it is paired with, both ways: adding, removing or moving a tab, and its filters, sort and Playable first. The newest change wins. Each tab's search text stays on its own PC. With this off, this PC neither sends its tabs nor takes another's.

favorites.label: Sync favourites with the host / clients
favorites.description: Keeps the favourites the same on this PC and the computers it is paired with, both ways, game by game: the newest change wins. Works for the games both computers have, and lets you favourite a host's game shown here (it becomes a favourite on the host). With this off, this PC neither sends its favourites nor takes another's.

playtime.label: Sync play time with the host / clients
playtime.description: Adds up the play time of the games both computers have: each computer's play sessions of them are copied to the other, so play time, last played, Played - Most and Played - Recently count both. Each session counts once. A game you stream from the host is timed on the host only; a host's game this PC does not have shows when it was last played there, so it is in Recent Games too. With this off, this PC neither sends its sessions nor takes another's, and neither tells nor shows when a host's games were last played.

tools: Sunshine (on the host) and Moonlight (on this PC) do the streaming. They are separate open-source programs under the GPL-3 licence, downloaded from their own releases the first time they are needed.

removeClient.title: Remove {name}?
removeClient.message: {name} will no longer see or stream this PC's games. It can pair again with a new PIN.

enabled.label: Let other PlayOut computers connect
enabled.description: Paired computers see this PC's installed games and ROMs, stream them and download the ROMs.

shareLogins.label: Share my logins with paired computers
shareLogins.description: Gives paired computers this PC's metadata logins (SteamGridDB, IGDB, ScreenScraper, TheGamesDB, Steam) and RetroAchievements account. They use them only for the services they have no login for. Sent over the paired, encrypted connection.

pair.label: Pair a computer
pair.enterPin: Enter this PIN on the other computer (Settings › Streaming › Connect to a host). Valid for {time}.
pair.afterProblem: Available once the problem above is fixed.
pair.starting: Available once the host has started…
pair.description: Shows a PIN to enter on the other computer. It stays paired until you remove it.

controllers.label: Controllers
controllers.description: Install the ViGEmBus driver so controllers on the other computer work in streamed games. Sunshine uses it to add a virtual gamepad.

client.title: Connect to a host
client.enterAddress: Enter the address of the host
client.enterPin: Enter the 4-digit PIN the host shows
client.paired: Paired with {name}. Its games appear in your library.

removeHost.title: Remove {name}?
removeHost.message: {name}'s games leave your library. You can pair again with a new PIN from it.

wan.saved: {name} is now looked for at {address} from other networks
wan.label: {name}'s internet address or name
wan.note: Where to find {name} from another network: its internet address (shown in Settings › Streaming on {name}) or a name pointing to it. Leave empty to forget it.

client.noHosts: No hosts paired yet. Turn on "Let other PlayOut computers connect" on the other computer, press Show PIN there, then find it here.

add.label: Add a host
add.description: Look for PlayOut computers on this network, or enter the address the host shows (also its internet address when it has port forwarding).

client.allPaired: Every PlayOut computer found is already paired.
client.noneFound: No PlayOut computers found. Check that the host is on with "Let other PlayOut computers connect", or enter its address.
client.moonlightMissing: Downloads the first time you stream a game.

showHostGames.label: Show games from paired computers
showHostGames.description: Games only a host has appear in your library with Stream or Download; games both have offer Stream from the host in their Play menu.

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: The stream's picture size. The host's game runs at it too.

bitrate.label: Bitrate
bitrate.description: Higher looks sharper but needs a faster network. Automatic picks one for the resolution and frame rate.

forwarding.noAutomatic: This router does not forward ports automatically
forwarding.byHand: {reason}. To connect from another network, forward TCP port {port} to this PC on your router (to stream too: TCP 47984, 47989 and 48010, UDP 47998 to 48000). This PC's internet address is {ip}.
forwarding.unavailable: Not available on this network: only computers on the same network can connect
forwarding.unavailableWhy: {error}: only computers on the same network can connect

status.locked_other: Too many wrong PINs. Pairing is locked for {count} more minutes.

emulationSync.conflicts_other: {count} conflicts: the newer copy kept, the older one in the backups
